input.summary: Checkout returns 500 for every card payment
input.description: Since the 14:20 deploy every card payment returns a 500. Cash on delivery still works. Rolled back is not an option, the deploy also carried the tax fix.

discussion.author: ops
discussion.body: Confirmed on prod, ~2000 failures in the last hour.

rubric.criteria: Places a live production failure correctly and does not ask for information it already has.

levels.5: urgent + bug, reason cites the 500s in production and the volume from the discussion, and `missing` is empty because the issue says what broke, when, and what still works.
levels.3: urgent + bug, but the reason is generic or it asks for information the issue already gave.
levels.1: Anything less than urgent, or a request for more information before acting.
